```yaml
name: Pull Request Beyla Integration Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*

jobs:
  generate-integration-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Generate integration matrix
        id: generate
        run: |
          WEIGHTS_FILE=${{ env.WEIGHTS_FILE || 'default_weights.json' }} ./internal/test/integration/generate-integration-matrix.sh
          echo "::set-output name=matrix::$(cat matrix.json)"

  run-integration-tests:
    needs: generate-integration-matrix
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix: ${needs.generate.outputs.matrix}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test -v ./internal/test/integration/${{ matrix.test }}

  notify-slack:
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [generate-integration-matrix, run-integration-tests]
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(needs.run-integration-tests.result) }}
          matrix: ${{ toJson(needs.generate.outputs.matrix) }}
          channel: '#beyla-ci'
          message: 'Integration tests completed.'
```

This workflow includes generating an integration test matrix based on a weights file, running the integration tests on self-hosted runners, and notifying Slack of the workflow status. The matrix generation can be customized using the `WEIGHTS_FILE` environment variable.
